knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 5.1.4
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) Name two simple loss functions. (2) What estimator does each typically justify? (3) Why are credible intervals not today's primary?
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Squared/absolute (and similar) loss map to posterior mean/median-type estimators as taught. Credible intervals are tomorrow.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 5.1.4
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Posterior for θ is available. (1) Under squared-error loss, what Bayesian point estimator do you use, and under absolute-error loss? (2) Refuse: 'The Bayesian point estimator under loss is the same object as a credible interval.'
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) Squared-error loss → posterior mean; absolute-error loss → posterior median. (2) Refuse: a point estimator summarises the posterior under a loss; a credible interval is a posterior probability set for θ — different objects.
